name: smwgraphics-radished-cliffside-and-bridges
title: Radished Cliffside and Bridges
description:
A foreground from my unfinished CLDC entry I polished up for Summer C3 2020. Featuring that style of cliff I always make, wood block and rope bridges, and giant... radish beet things.

Each piece is separated into its own set of files, and the palettes are formatted 5/3/5, smwcp2 standard palette style, for maximum compatibility and easy recoloring. Enjoy!
